# Closed covariant slot ownership

A closed generic collection parent and its plain child combine checked key
bridges with no-argument covariant clone bridges. Complete original contracts
and runtime slots must survive both source and external provider recovery.

Frozen callers and future overrides check receiver effects, checked forwarding,
callbacks, result identity, late casts, partial writes and exact exceptions.
Typed, erased and special clone entries are observed independently. Recompiled
classes retain every original method, access role, Signature and Exceptions.
